sources.role: Proved expander results and numerical shrinker assertions are distinguished in their catalogue entries.
checked_passages: Section 2 Lemmas 2,3 and Theorem 4 read; PDF14 visually inspected. Qualitative double-cone results proved. Computed genus-three shrinker and angle decimals excluded from proof claims.

All article text read for this review; Figure 2, printed p. 1943 (PDF p. 8), visually checked. Section 1 and Assertion 1, pp. 1940–1944: numerical genus-three shrinker and intended symmetries/asymptotics. Section 3, pp. 1953–1955: numerical aperture. Section 4, p. 1956: conditional Main Result, separate from the qualitative theorems of Section 2.
